🔨 Customize your own ship!

games.name: Visual Pianos 🎹
games.desc:
Welcome to Visual Pianos, the best pianos on Roblox.

Play piano, perform with friends, and bring your favorite songs to life. We're a multiplayer music experience with customizable instruments, beautiful worlds, and spectacular visual trails.

🎹 Play solo, duet with friends, or perform for others. Show off your skills!
🎶 Choose from over 200+ different soundfonts; the largest collection on Roblox.
🎺 Type sf+ to mix and match up to 4 different instruments to play together!
🎨 Customize your piano, colors, trails, and visual effects. Express yourself!
🎛️ Play with QWERTY, MIDI, mobile, or tablet controls. Play VP wherever you are!
🤖 Type >auto to autoplay your favorite music sheets for free. 
🐾 Collect exclusive pets and discover more secrets throughout the game.

games.name: Don’t Steal the Brainrots 🧠
games.desc:
Welcome to Don’t Steal the Brainrots! 🧠

How to Play:
• Sneak up and steal Brainrots while they sleep! 😴
• RUN when they wake up and chase you! 🏃
• Take them home and collect tons of cash! 💸
• Upgrade your characters to earn even more! 🔥
• Expand your plot to unlock extra slots! 🏗️
• Trade & gift Brainrots with friends to grow together! 🎁
• But be careful... a sleeping Brainrot can WAKE at any second! 🤫

Remember, your Brainrots earn cash even while you're offline! ⏰

👍 Like the game & join the group for FREE Cash!

games.name: Carry A Friend! (Teamwork Obby)
games.desc:
Welcome to Carry A Friend! (Teamwork Obby)!

Help your friend help you - carry, throw or pickup your friend and press different buttons to access different areas and progress in each obby. There are many 2 player obby puzzles and levels to choose from! Train your parkour abilities and reach the final level! 

💡How To Play: 
- Press E on a player to pair up with them! 👥
- Press E to pickup or throw your friend! 👤 
- Press the buttons ⬛ 
- Progress and don't leave anyone behind 🏆 
- Reach the END of the levels 🎌 
- Get in the Top Leaderboards 🌐 

Tags: Colorful, Super, Speed, Fun, Obby, Parkour, Teamwork, Run, Victory, Win, Faster, Platformer, Clicker, Easy
